traveler_details_transport_preferences_r.name: traveler_details_transport_preferences_require_none
traveler_details_transport_preferences_r.value: ("traveler_details"."transport_mode" = 'none') OR ("traveler_details"."carpool_preference" IS NULL AND "traveler_details"."parking_preference" IS NULL)

traveler_details_carpool_driver_consiste.name: traveler_details_carpool_driver_consistent
traveler_details_carpool_driver_consiste.value: ("traveler_details"."carpool_role" = 'passenger' AND "traveler_details"."carpool_driver_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "traveler_details"."carpool_driver_user_id" <> "traveler_details"."user_id") OR ("traveler_details"."carpool_role" <> 'passenger' AND "traveler_details"."carpool_driver_user_id" IS NULL)
